messages:
Jordan: quick ping — PR #2527 ready for merge but CI is tripping on a style/lint edgecase. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2527
Jordan: change is a tiny rename to align export naming + a compatibility alias. locally `gofmt` & tests pass. CI golangci-lint failing with a golint message about an exported const.
Jordan: snippet:
```go
// prefer this name to match pkg conventions
const DefaultAPIKeyName = "redwood_default"

// kept for compatibility with older packages
const DefaultAPIKey = DefaultAPIKeyName
```
Maria: quick question — did you add a comment on the exported const? golint wants a doc comment for exported names. :thinking:
Sam: also check if any generated files still reference `DefaultAPIKey` (mockgen, codegen). sometimes that causes CI to see the old symbol.
Jordan: i did add a comment but CI still flags:
```
/.../config/keys.go:12:6: exported const DefaultAPIKey should have comment or be unexported (golint)
```
Jordan: i grepped the repo; found one reference in `tools/mockgen/generated_mocks.go` — updated mock and pushed.
Lucy: tiny nit — there's a trailing space on the comment line; gofmt -w removed it locally. can you run `gofmt -w` in CI?
Jordan: ran `gofmt -w` and pushed fix, new commit c3f4a7c. also left the compatibility alias to avoid a migration blast.
ci-bot: golangci-lint check — FAILED (windows) — failing job: `golangci-lint (windows)` due to path-length precommit hook.
Sam: hmm, path-length on windows is flaky. i'll re-run that job (windows runners) in ~5m.
Maria: i looked through the change — naming + alias makes sense to me. :+1:
Lucy: lgtm after the gofmt fix. thanks for the alias — reduces blast radius. :+1:
Sam: re-run finished — CI green now.
ci-bot: all checks passed — PR is mergeable and queued.
Sam: i can merge when the merge window opens at 09:00 PST unless anyone objects.
Maria: no objections from me.
Jordan: thanks folks — i'll watch logs after merge for any weirdness. :eyes:
